sources.note: Main vendor homepage. Describes BlueEHR as solving fragmented healthcare IT with product+platform approach. Lists modules for acute, ambulatory, behavioral health, dental, telemedicine, RCM, patient engagement.
ONC certification details for BlueEHR Version 3 (CHPL ID 15.02.05.3076.ZHHC.01.02.1.220119). Lists 35+ certified criteria. References EHI export documentation and FHIR APIs.

OpenEMR wiki page for ZH Healthcare. Confirms ZH Healthcare is a leading developer/contributor to OpenEMR. BlueEHR is their commercial platform built on OpenEMR. Lists extensive commit history of contributions.
January 2017 press release announcing unified blueEHR brand, replacing BlueEHS and HITaaS branding.

September 2017 press release. Sanford World Clinic selected blueEHR for 20 rural clinics in Ghana. Describes platform as serving thousands of providers in 100+ countries with EHR, RCM, patient portal, telehealth, pharmacy, labs, radiology modules.
Press release describing blueEHR as 34-module suite covering ambulatory (including dental), acute care, telemedicine, patient engagement and analytics. Includes behavioral health component.

FindEMR product profile. Lists 30 modules covering ambulatory, acute, telemedicine, patient engagement. Features include e-prescribing, lab integration, patient portal, scheduling, billing. Supports cardiology, dentistry, ophthalmology, radiology. Built for 1500+ users, multi-language.

Software Finder profile. 4.4/5 rating from 21 reviews. Custom pricing. Lists patient demographics, clinical documentation, scheduling, billing, lab results, e-prescribing. Notes connectivity issues with other vendors as concern.
EHR Reviews profile. Lists e-prescribing, lab integration, HPI documentation, video conferencing, mobile apps, HIPAA/HL7/ICD-10/CPT compliance. Charting rated 9.5/10, templates 9.4/10.

EMRSystems profile. Describes multi-specialty EMR with patient engagement, demographics, appointment management, voice recognition, RCM, analytics, charting, e-prescribing. Customizable workflows for cardiology, radiology, dentistry, ophthalmology.
Capterra profile. Users praise customization capabilities. Notes that inventory management module is incomplete and does not account for laboratory items.
Software Advice profile (returned 403 on fetch). Listed as blueBriX Software, confirming the rebranding.
BlueBriX platform website (successor branding to blueEHR). Positions as value-based care and integrated EHR platform with RCM services.
BlueBriX about page (blueehr.com/leadership redirects here). Limited detail accessible; confirms blueBriX as the current parent brand.
BlueBriX/blueEHR knowledge base. Two main product categories: blueConsole (app building/integration hub) and blueEHR (EHR delivery). Active documentation with FAQs.
